records.title: Mobile app: jobs not appearing after sync
records.body: Ask the engineer to pull-to-refresh, confirm app version is current, and check the job is allocated to them for today. If several engineers are affected, escalate to Tier-2 as a possible sync service incident.

records.title: Mobile app: photos and signatures stuck in outbox
records.body: Items stay in the outbox when the device is offline or storage is full. Do not uninstall the app - unsynced data will be lost.

records.title: Understanding your invoice and seat counts
records.body: Invoices bill for active seats on the billing date. Deactivated users still count until the next cycle. Billing can issue a pro-rata credit note on request.

records.title: Duplicate or incorrect charges
records.body: Collect the invoice number(s) and payment dates and route to Billing. Tier-1 must not promise refunds.

records.title: Card declined or direct debit failed
records.body: Never ask customers to send card details by email or ticket. Send the secure payment-portal link. Accounts are suspended 14 days after a failed payment.

records.title: Reallocating a job or recurring PPM visit
records.body: Open the job, choose Reallocate, pick the engineer and new window. For recurring visits choose 'this and future visits'.

records.title: Engineer no-show on a live job
records.body: Check the engineer's live status on the scheduling board, contact the engineer, and update the end customer. Treat as P2 when the customer is waiting on site.

records.title: Resetting a password or MFA
records.body: Admins can reset other users. If the ADMIN is locked out, Tier-1 verifies identity using two account facts before triggering a reset.

records.title: Importing assets and sites from CSV
records.body: Use the import template. 'Site Ref' must match an existing site. Ask for a 5-row sample of the file when imports fail.

records.title: Exporting job history for reporting
records.body: Reports > Job History > Export CSV. Exports over 50k rows are emailed when ready.

records.title: PDF quotes or invoices generating blank
records.body: Usually a template field error. Collect an example job number and the template name; route to Tier-2.

records.title: Scheduling board slow or freezing
records.body: Clear filters, try another browser. If multiple users report it, check status page and escalate to Tier-2.

records.title: Submitting product feedback
records.body: Log feature requests in the Product feedback queue with the customer's use case. Do not promise delivery dates.

records.title: Cancellation and renewal requests
records.body: Any mention of cancelling, switching provider, or not renewing goes to Customer Success the same day. Do not offer discounts from Tier-1.

records.title: What support can and cannot help with
records.body: We support the software only. We cannot advise on trade pricing, equipment brands, or third-party systems we do not integrate with.
